items.title: Wholesale inflation jumps to 12.29% in October due to rising crude and power prices
items.author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
items.description: In October, wholesale inflation in India surged to 12.29%, up from 11.39% in September. This increase was largely driven by a dramatic rise in fuel and power prices, which skyrocketed to 32.84%. While crude petroleum and natural gas prices soared by 70.80%, primary food articles experienced only a slight inflation uptick. Meanwhile, manufactured goods showed minor easing, resulting in a cumulative WPI inflation of 10.14% from April to October.

items.description: After four centuries, the 16th-century brass lock from the Ann Francis shipwreck has finally been unlocked. Though the letters' meaning remains a mystery, the padlock is now proudly exhibited at the National Waterfront Museum, highlighting its importance in maritime history.

items.title: Bigger pay may make you more diligent, slightly less agreeable
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Research shows that an increase in salary can correlate with changes in personality traits over time. Higher income leads to an increase in conscientiousness and emotional stability, reflecting how individuals approach work. However, this increase may also be associated with a decrease in agreeableness and extraversion. The study involved a large sample of workers across five countries over several years.

items.author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
items.description: Oil prices are on a downward trend due to an anticipated surplus and a recovery in shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. items.title: Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites as ULA's Vulcan rocket fails minutes after launch
items.author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
items.description: Amazon's planned launch of 40 satellites for its Leo internet network failed after the Vulcan rocket malfunctioned. The Vulcan rocket, operated by United Launch Alliance, experienced an anomaly 10 minutes after liftoff. This failure poses a setback for Amazon's satellite internet plans, which aim to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. Amazon has also invested in other launch options including Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket and Arianespace.

items.title: Banks propose alternative plan to soften bond revaluation blow
items.description: In an effort to adapt to shifting market dynamics, several banks in India are considering a yield-based accounting approach for held to maturity bonds. This strategy, proposed by FIMMDA, seeks to counteract potential valuation rule impacts and prevent immediate balance sheet losses that could adversely affect lending capacity. Traditional straight-line accounting methods would risk bank reserves, prompting ongoing discussions between banks and regulators for a viable solution.

items.author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
items.description: ‘Ramayana’ continues its record run, earning Rs 75 crore on its second Sunday (day 11) to post Bollywood’s biggest second Sunday, beating ‘Dhurandhar 2’. items.title: 'Not Cuba or Venezuela': Iran warns it will not wait for US attack before responding
items.author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
items.description: Iran has expressed that it is ready for potential military action while discussing diplomatic avenues with the United States. Deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi indicated three possible scenarios: diplomatic talks, economic blockades, and military response. Tehran has set specific conditions, including ending the war and lifting economic sanctions for any agreement. The arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt in the Middle East adds to ongoing regional tensions.

items.title: FPI buying hits 5-year high in November. What's driving the $7.5 billion inflow?
items.description: Foreign portfolio investors returned to the Indian equity scene with a robust investment of $7.5 billion in early November, signaling a shift after a streak of outflows. Key influences on this development included falling crude oil prices and profit-taking related to AI shares. Simultaneously, domestic institutional investors sold stocks amid rising foreign flows, indicating a divergence in market trends.

items.title: She slept through chess at 5, now she's India's 88th Grandmaster
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Initially disinterested in chess, Divya Deshmukh found her passion with the encouragement of her family. She rapidly rose through the ranks, claiming the title of national champion and later earning global fame by winning the FIDE Women's World Cup. As India's 88th Grandmaster, her accomplishments, recognized with the Arjuna Award from President Droupadi Murmu in 2026, aim to motivate young girls to embrace chess and pursue their dreams.
